reference_machine: Apple M5, 16 GiB RAM, macOS 26.6.2; optimized development profile; Bevy 0.18.1
conditions: Warm OS file cache; user preview remained open. Million run overlapped workspace compilation/tests. This checkpoint precedes bounded inspector and tightened default external-peer budget; synthetic views do not exceed that peer ceiling. Single runs; reported percentiles are across heterogeneous actions, not independent repeated trials.

notes: Synthetic sparse 32-way ownership workload with declared peer/shared-leaf dependencies. This is not production complexity or human comprehension evidence.

Preflight reads only bounded manifest/footer bytes and checks generator counts; the real native worker performs the sole full index. No provider index is pre-opened. OS filesystem cache temperature is uncontrolled and must be reported by the runner.

Initial acceptance starts before app/plugin construction and includes GPU startup plus worker indexing/projection/validation. First screenshot completion is reported separately. Per-action acceptance is observed after ticket completion with loading false, before three subsequent settlement frames or screenshot work.
CPU update intervals include benchmark instrumentation and are not GPU presentation latency. Intervals touching screenshot scheduling/pending/completion are excluded from worker/idle summaries.

Return classification follows the actual runtime cache capacity of16 and distinct navigation history; no replacement cache or cache-hit hook is used. Resident and eviction-expected returns are not claimed as directly instrumented cache hits. Exact rendered mesh bounds/transforms, IDs, and connector point bits are compared on all returns, including after pressure exceeds16 distinct focuses.

Every accepted scene is bounded to250 object representations. Partial relationship pages remain explicitly reported; the test does not claim every model relationship is simultaneously resident. Original rendered membership IDs are checked against the generator's supplied dependency definitions.
runs.peak_rss_measurement: External /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size; join by process_id/run output. No resident-memory estimate is substituted.
